item.virtual_redstone_wire.virtual_cable: No consumption, reusable. Right-click input block then output block to create a one-way redstone link
Max distance: 256 blocks. Redstone signal strength propagates along the link
Right-click a block to cut all cable links that start from it
Only affects links where this block is the input (source)
item.virtual_redstone_wire.cable_magnifi: Right-click a block to inspect cable links. Highlighted when held
Blue outline=input, yellow outline=output, red line=link path
message.virtual_redstone_wire.too_far: Target is too far away! Max distance: %d blocks
config.virtual_redstone_wire.maxLinkDist: Maximum distance (in blocks) for a virtual cable connection
